description: This file contains a Python class `AirflowClient` that provides an asynchronous interface for interacting with the Airflow REST API v2. It includes methods to trigger DAG runs, fetch DAG run statuses, and wait for DAG runs to complete, as well as associated data models such as `DagRunInfo`. The file also defines a factory function to instantiate the client using project-specific settings.

classes.name: DagRunInfo
classes.description: Container for Airflow DAG run information, used for representing the state and details of DAG runs.

classes.name: AirflowClient
classes.description: A simple async HTTP client for interacting with Airflow's REST API, capable of triggering DAGs, fetching status, and waiting for DAG completion.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str, username: Optional[str] = None, password: Optional[str] = None, timeout: float = 10.0)
methods.description: Initializes the AirflowClient with base URL and optional authentication.

methods.name: "AirflowClient" __aenter__(self)
methods.description: Enables use of async context management, ensuring client is initialized.

methods.name: None __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb)
methods.description: Ensures cleanup of the HTTP client upon exit from async context.

methods.name: None _ensure_client(self)
methods.description: Lazy initialization of the internal httpx.AsyncClient, setting authentication headers if credentials are provided.

methods.name: DagRunInfo trigger_dag(self, dag_id: str, conf: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Triggers a DAG run in Airflow with optional configuration parameters, returns a DagRunInfo object.

methods.name: DagRunInfo get_dag_run(self, dag_id: str, dag_run_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the status and details of a specific DAG run by ID.

methods.name: DagRunInfo wait_for_dag_run(self, dag_id: str, dag_run_id: str, poll_interval: float = 10.0, timeout: float = 3600.0)
methods.description: Polls the status of a DAG run until it reaches a terminal state ('success' or 'failed') or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: AirflowClient get_airflow_client()
methods.description: Factory function to instantiate an AirflowClient using project settings.
